## Project rules

The rules below are requirements in `requirements.yaml`, typed as in ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018. Each is checked by the tests named under it; the status is from the last test run. Keep to every rule that holds. A broken rule is the first thing to fix, or to raise with a person if the rule itself looks wrong. Change a rule by editing `requirements.yaml`, never this block.

### Design constraints (§9.6.16)

- **The shop package shall import only the Python standard library and its own modules.** (`rules.stdlib-only`)
  Why: The shop runs on a till with no network access to a package index; every dependency so far has broken an install there.
  Verified by: `tests/test_rules.py::test_the_shop_imports_only_the_standard_library` — holds in the last run
- **Money amounts shall be Decimal values, with no float anywhere in the shop package.** (`rules.decimal-money`)
  Why: A float total once made a refund one cent short and the accounts would not reconcile.
  Verified by: `tests/test_rules.py::test_money_never_touches_float` — holds in the last run
- **Only shop.gateway shall open database or network connections.** (`rules.gateway-io`)
  Why: Tests swap the gateway for a fake; IO anywhere else made the suite hit the real database.
  Verified by: `tests/test_rules.py::test_only_the_gateway_does_io` — holds in the last run
- **Each user-facing message shall come from shop.i18n through t(), in each supported language.** (`rules.i18n`)
  Why: Half the shop's staff read Japanese; a message added in English only shows them a KeyError.
  Verified by: `tests/test_rules.py::test_every_message_comes_from_i18n` — holds in the last run
- **Modules other than shop.cli shall report through logging.** (`rules.no-print`)
  Why: The shop is also driven by a web front end that captures logs; prints from library code vanish there.
  Verified by: `tests/test_rules.py::test_only_the_cli_prints` — holds in the last run
- **Timestamps shall come from shop.clock.now().** (`rules.utc-clock`)
  Why: Naive local timestamps put orders on the wrong day for the overnight batch.
  Verified by: `tests/test_rules.py::test_time_comes_from_the_clock` — holds in the last run
